steps.description: Analyze current project structure — read pom.xml, identify dependencies and Java/Spring Boot versions

suggestions: Read pom.xml first to identify current Spring Boot version, Java version, and all dependencies.
Note all javax.* imports across Java source files — these will all need migration to jakarta.*.

steps.description: Update Java version from 8 to 21 in pom.xml and verify compiler configuration
Upgrade Spring Boot parent version from 2.7.x to 3.2.x in pom.xml

suggestions: Change the spring-boot-starter-parent version to 3.2.x — this pulls in Jakarta EE 10 and Hibernate 6.

steps.description: Migrate javax.* namespace to jakarta.* in all Java files

suggestions: Replace ALL javax.persistence.*, javax.validation.*, javax.servlet.* imports with jakarta.* equivalents.
A bulk sed replacement works well: sed -i 's/javax\.persistence/jakarta.persistence/g' $(find . -name '*.java')
warnings: javax.sql.*, javax.crypto.* and other Java SE packages do NOT move to jakarta — only the EE namespaces migrate.

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Spring Boot 3.x requires jakarta.* namespaces. Replace 'import javax.persistence' → 'import jakarta.persistence', 'import javax.validation' → 'import jakarta.validation', etc.

steps.description: Update Spring Security 6 — replace deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter with SecurityFilterChain

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter was removed in Spring Security 6. Replace it with a @Bean returning SecurityFilterChain: @Bean public SecurityFilterChain securityFilterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception { ... }

steps.description: Run mvn clean compile to verify compilation, then run mvn test to ensure all tests pass

suggestions: Run 'mvn clean compile' first to catch import errors before running the full test suite.
If compilation fails, check for remaining javax.* imports or API changes between versions.
